spec.description: Waiting-on-me landing board (v2 state vocabulary). Row 1 lists every run blocked on a human action with the exact command; row 2 lists machine-blocked / retry waits; row 3 is the live state of all runs. Retry ledger, gate decisions and worktree sweep keep their v1-compatible metrics.

spec.expr: count(pi_flow_state{state="running", mode=~"${mode:raw}", ref=~"$ref"} or pi_flow_state{state="waiting_machine", reason="subagent_in_flight", mode=~"${mode:raw}", ref=~"$ref"}) or vector(0)

spec.description: Runs actively working: orchestrator mid-turn (state=running) or an implementation/review subagent in flight (waiting_machine, reason=subagent_in_flight). No human action needed.
spec.title: Running now

spec.expr:
label_replace(label_replace(
  (label_join(max by (ref, mode) (pi_flow_state{state="waiting_human", mode=~"${mode:raw}", ref=~"$ref"}) * on (ref) group_left (title) topk by (ref) (1, pi_flow_run_title_info{mode=~"${mode:raw}", ref=~"$ref"}), "ticket", " — ", "ref", "title")
  or
  label_replace(max by (ref, mode) (pi_flow_state{state="waiting_human", mode=~"${mode:raw}", ref=~"$ref"}) unless on (ref) pi_flow_run_title_info{mode=~"${mode:raw}", ref=~"$ref"}, "ticket", "$1", "ref", "(.+)")),
  "url", "https://salaryhero.atlassian.net/browse/$1", "ref", "(.+)"),
  "url", "", "mode", "^$|personal")

spec.description: Runs blocked on YOU. Reason is value-mapped to the command that unblocks it (mirrors flow/vocabulary.ts EXPECTED_ACTION); substitute the ref from the Ref column. Waiting = live seconds in the current wait (time() - state start), so it ages without a push. — = no registered action (e.g. a legacy run with no reason).
spec.title: Waiting on me — act now

subagent_ask_pending.text: answer the subagent (its pane or answer_subagent)

spec.expr: time() - max by (ref) (pi_flow_state_start_seconds{state="waiting_machine", reason!="subagent_in_flight", mode=~"${mode:raw}", ref=~"$ref"})

label_replace(label_replace(
  (label_join(max by (ref, mode) (pi_flow_state{state="waiting_machine", reason!="subagent_in_flight", mode=~"${mode:raw}", ref=~"$ref"}) * on (ref) group_left (title) topk by (ref) (1, pi_flow_run_title_info{mode=~"${mode:raw}", ref=~"$ref"}), "ticket", " — ", "ref", "title")
  or
  label_replace(max by (ref, mode) (pi_flow_state{state="waiting_machine", reason!="subagent_in_flight", mode=~"${mode:raw}", ref=~"$ref"}) unless on (ref) pi_flow_run_title_info{mode=~"${mode:raw}", ref=~"$ref"}, "ticket", "$1", "ref", "(.+)")),
  "url", "https://salaryhero.atlassian.net/browse/$1", "ref", "(.+)"),
  "url", "", "mode", "^$|personal")

spec.description: Runs waiting on the MACHINE, not you — retry/blocker budget waits, label misses. No action column (these self-clear or need a code/label fix). Stalled for = live seconds in waiting_machine; Attempts/Blocker retries are the kept pi_flow_retry_attempts / pi_flow_blocker_retries ledgers; Machine wait = cumulative pi_flow_wait_seconds{wait_kind="machine"}.
spec.title: Retry-blocked / machine waits

spec.expr:
label_replace(label_replace(
  (label_join(max by (ref, mode) (pi_flow_state{mode=~"${mode:raw}", ref=~"$ref"}) * on (ref) group_left (title) topk by (ref) (1, pi_flow_run_title_info{mode=~"${mode:raw}", ref=~"$ref"}), "ticket", " — ", "ref", "title")
  or
  label_replace(max by (ref, mode) (pi_flow_state{mode=~"${mode:raw}", ref=~"$ref"}) unless on (ref) pi_flow_run_title_info{mode=~"${mode:raw}", ref=~"$ref"}, "ticket", "$1", "ref", "(.+)")),
  "url", "https://salaryhero.atlassian.net/browse/$1", "ref", "(.+)"),
  "url", "", "mode", "^$|personal")

spec.description: All runs on the v2 vocabulary: current state + reason (enum), the in-flight phase/step, and how long the run has sat in its current state (In state). Started / Last pushed are the kept pi_flow_run_start_seconds / push_time_seconds freshness signals — a ref whose Last pushed is old has stopped emitting. Click a ticket to drill into Health. Top-level runs only.
spec.title: Live state — all runs

subagent_ask_pending.text: answer the subagent (its pane or answer_subagent)

spec.expr:
(label_join(sum by (ref, mode) (pi_flow_retry_attempts{mode=~"${mode:raw}", ref=~"$ref"}) * on (ref) group_left (title) topk by (ref) (1, pi_flow_run_title_info{mode=~"${mode:raw}", ref=~"$ref"}), "ticket", " — ", "ref", "title")
  or
  label_replace(sum by (ref, mode) (pi_flow_retry_attempts{mode=~"${mode:raw}", ref=~"$ref"}) unless on (ref) pi_flow_run_title_info{mode=~"${mode:raw}", ref=~"$ref"}, "ticket", "$1", "ref", "(.+)"))

spec.description: Attempt ledger: flow_run_attempt budget usage (pi_flow_retry_attempts) plus loop blocker retries (pi_flow_blocker_retries). 3 attempts = escalation to the human (see the Waiting-on-me queue).
spec.title: Retries per ticket (attempt ledger + blockers)

spec.description: Raw gate-answer events (pi_flow_gate_decisions_total) — reject→approve churn is visible as multiple choices on one gate.
spec.title: Gate decisions by gate and choice
